placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Ashton Court is a good choice when everyone needs space to stretch their legs. Explore the estate on foot, look out over Bristol and watch the deer from the designated paths.

Our family idea: choose a short out-and-back walk before settling down for a picnic. Let children look for different leaf shapes along the way; there is no need to cover the whole estate in one visit.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Picnics, wildlife watching and families who enjoy a walk.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Estate cafes, toilets and walking routes.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Use the estate car parks and check charges and gate closing times on arrival.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Some routes are steep or uneven. Keep your distance from the deer and use the official access guide to choose a suitable route.
